notes.title: Freezing Update! - Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello! 

I'm back with the new patch!

What's changed?

     4 new upgrades

         Dry Ice (Freeze Power +20, Freeze Time +3 seconds)
         Freeze Bomb (Freeze Power +30, Ultimate Freeze Chance +5%)
         Longer Break (Freeze Power +10, Freeze Time +3 seconds)
         Ultimate Freezer (Freeze Power +30, Ultimate Freeze Chance +10%)

     Auto Aim option can be set in settings
     Fixed some translation issues

notes.content:
Hello! 

I'm back with the new patch!

What's changed?

 Long Range (Critical Chance +3%, Piercing +1)

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Long time no see!

I've been working on finishing and polishing the game for the past couple of weeks. The game will be released soon, so I decided to update the demo version as well! There are many new upgrades, so you will have much more fun playing the game :D

Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo 1.03 - Burn them all!
notes.content:
Hello!

Changes:


     Burning upgrade tree (4 new upgrades)
     Removed dash - still thinking what to do with it, maybe it will come back with slightly different behavior
     Fixed not applying critical damage to some enemies bug


Have fun playing!
